_about: Proposed Editor look rows (pm7-editor-customizer, 2026-10-14; /mnt/Cursor/share/puppet-master/2026-10-14-editor-customizer/PROPOSAL-canon.md). They are not canon: Plans/settings_inventory.json does not hold them. tools/build.py (EDITOR_LOOK_ROWS) admits each one into the base page's embedded inventories before the Settings layer reads them, unless canon already holds its id, so the concept's Settings, search, Details, transfer and the editor treat them as the rows they are proposed to become. Shape: the inventory's own. Category code, subgroup editing (Editor & Terminal > Editing), scope global, stored per Project like SSYS-050's editor rows. The editor reads each through home-redesign src/panels/kinds/09-editor-look.js (LINK).

rows.label: Switch Editor Colors With Light and Dark
rows.desc: When the app changes between light and dark, a scheme you picked for the editor swaps for its family's other version, such as Catppuccin Latte and Mocha. Follow look always does.

rows.label: Bracket Pair Colors
rows.desc: Matching brackets share a color, a different one at each depth, so you can see which closes which. A closing bracket with no opener shows in the error color.

rows.label: Editor Text Contrast
rows.desc: The least contrast every color of code keeps against the editor's background. 4.5:1 is the standard every scheme already meets; 7:1 moves dim colors lighter or darker, never changing their hue.

rows.label: Comments in Italics
rows.desc: Draws comments in the face's italic. Follow look uses the look's own style: italic in most looks, upright in Retro dark.

rows.label: Keywords in Bold
rows.desc: Draws keywords heavier than the rest of the code. Follow look uses the look's own weight: bold in Retro and NieR Mode, regular elsewhere.

rows.label: Editor Text Weight
rows.desc: How heavy code is, on faces that come in weights: JetBrains Mono from 400 to 800, Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono from 200 to 800, the system monospace from 400 to 700.

rows.label: Editor Letter Spacing
rows.desc: Extra space between characters of code, in pixels. Columns stay aligned, since every character takes the same width.

rows.label: Editor Ligatures
rows.desc: Joins pairs such as -> and != into one symbol where the face has them (JetBrains Mono). Each still takes its own columns, so the caret and selection are unchanged.

rows.label: Editor Caret Shape
rows.desc: The shape of the editor's caret. Follow look uses the look's own: a line in most looks, a block in Retro.

rows.label: Editor Caret Width
rows.desc: How thick the line caret is, in pixels.

rows.label: Editor Caret Blink
rows.desc: How the caret blinks: on and off, fading, growing from its middle, or not at all. Reduce motion keeps it solid.

rows.label: Editor Caret Movement
rows.desc: Whether the caret jumps to where it goes or glides there. Typing never waits for it. Reduce motion makes it jump.

rows.label: Editor Caret Trail
rows.desc: A brief trail from where the caret was when it jumps further than a few lines, such as to a search match or a line you named, so your eyes follow it. Clicks and typing make none.

rows.label: Count Lines From the Caret
rows.desc: Line numbers count up and down from the caret's line, which keeps its own number.

rows.label: Highlight the Current Line
rows.desc: How the caret's line stands out: a band across the line and a brighter number, the band only, the number only, or nothing.

rows.label: Indent Guides
rows.desc: Thin vertical lines at each level of indentation. Rainbow gives each level its own color.

rows.label: Light the Guide of the Block I'm In
rows.desc: With indent guides on, the guide of the block that holds the caret is drawn brighter.

rows.label: Show Spaces
rows.desc: Marks spaces with faint dots: between words where there are several, only in the selection, only at the ends of lines, or everywhere.

rows.label: Rulers
rows.desc: Faint vertical lines at the columns lines are meant to stay within.

rows.label: Wrap Long Lines At
rows.desc: Where wrapped lines break: at the edge of the editor, or at a column (or the edge, if that comes first). Applies while Wrap Long Lines is on.

rows.label: Sticky Scroll Lines
rows.desc: The most enclosing lines sticky scroll keeps in view, from 1 to 5.

rows.label: Smooth Scrolling in the Editor
rows.desc: Scrolling with the wheel or by a page glides instead of jumping. Follow look uses the look's own: on in Friendly and Glass. Reduce motion turns it off.

rows.label: Lines Arrive When a File Opens
rows.desc: The first screen of a file arrives line by line from the top, quickly. Off shows it at once. Reduce motion always shows it at once.

rows.label: Scroll Past the Last Line
rows.desc: How far you can scroll below the last line, so it need not sit at the bottom edge.

rows.label: Fade Editors I'm Not In
rows.desc: When you are working in another panel, editors you are not in fade back a little, as Dim Terminals I'm Not In does for terminals.

rows.label: Editor Scanlines
rows.desc: Thin dark lines across the code, like an old monitor. They never move.

rows.label: Editor Text Glow
rows.desc: A soft glow around code in its own color, like phosphor on a tube.
